title: ChatRateGuard
description: Adds a simple cooldown between chat messages.
body:
# ChatRateGuard

Adds a cooldown between chat messages.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Permissions
- `chatrateguard.bypass`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
cooldown-seconds: 2
message: "&cSlow down!"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
